notes.title: Patch note 1.1.0 - Orion
notes.notes:
Sorry for keep you waiting, the Orion has come! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/6dcee48201539a8838814639b060325c3875a16f.png

Dacapo
Main Weapon : Bird Strike - Dacapo releases illusion bird in mouse direction dealing damage to all hit enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/012544efd6727f6abe4408e4d17b959e5c1ac51f.gif
Skill : Awakening of Sacred Bird - Whenever Dacapo collects 5 rosaries, he will transform into Sacred bird form incredibly increasing speed and calling Daca's uncle for assistance.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/8af263a7a39f32524e5c1826b338ff5f9c9a0f7b.gif

Baabel
Main Weapon : Holy Beam - Baabel uses divine power to summon the light of God to attack enemies at the mouse position
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/788cff3cc616f4f618cf893cdda8f7795f82065d.gif
Skill : Awakening of Baphomet - Whenever Baabel defeats 30 enemies, he will transform into Baphomet. His weapon will change from Holy Beam to Dark Beam, and he will attack continuously without cooldown.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/e4b8eb3a1f78dae720008adbcee2e2f80850ae6d.gif

Schneider 
Main Weapon : Cthulhu call - Schneider summons Cthulhu from his Grimoire based on the mouse position. The summoned Cthulhu can be in various direction.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/78f2fa3f7034a06ce7945751b19e1252ff221fe8.gif
Skill : Awakening of Darkhold - Every once in a while, Cthulhu will throw the Book of Darkness for you, which, when picked up, will grant you various effect.

Red Grimoire >> increases ATK damage
Blue Grimoire >> increases ATK speed
Green Grimoire >> increases Move speed
Gold Grimoire >> increases pick up radius
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/fa803d8f89c41d1ee9beb8f540d9e84ea420adb1.gif

notes.title: Patch note 0.3.0
notes.notes:
In this patch, we add some logic and balance adjusting to encourage you to use items other than sustainable items which have played very important role since the game is published.

Features

 Now player will restore some HP when level up. We hope that this healing will give player more choice to play around.


Balance adjustments

 Reduce Selene weapon LV 7 healing amount.
 Increase Backpatch effect percentage.


Apocalypse map

 Change some building on the map.
 Rework art and hitbox of obstacle which hard to be seen.
 Increase the size of hitbox that make obstacles fade when player near them.


Weapon

 Rework Solar weapon LV7 flare art.
 Rework Zenith rapier effect art.
 Rework Ryuusei-ken art.


Enemy

 Rework Outer god art and size.

notes.title: v0.2.2 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hot fix
- Fix game crashing when encore in medley mode which has duplicated songs.

notes.title: Major patch 0.2 is now available.
notes.notes:
Hi! everyone, we come back with the new major feature Encore mode!

Encore mode
Here come our new feature, Encore mode. Encore mode will be available, when player clear the stage once. Players can encore after they defeat the boss. After encore, the game will continue with the random song, and now the game will last long until player die.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/68fe378b9de460ef1f8dd98a5db118106c2e2915.png

Mouse Intregration
Dragon claw, S1R beam, Star sword, Base bonk bat, Atlaz arc, Knuckle and Meteor now can be controlled by mouse.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/595229dc5f0047a9dc8385ae03be53fbcdc135f0.png

Addition UI that makes mouse usage more comfortable have been included.
Take note that we change only default control, so players who have played the game have to change the control in settings.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44686205/6ec8875fa98579bb9160f05cbb4b55fc17119bad.png

Quality of life
Weapon opacity is now able to be adjusted in setting.
